params.caption: 🎮 EA shakes up Battlefield leadership with another ex-Call of Duty boss EA has reshuffled who runs its studios group and the Battlefield franchise. Byron Beede, until now Battlefield's general manager, has been promoted to group general manager, while another former Call of Duty executive steps in to lead every project across Battlefield Studios. It's the latest sign EA is leaning on Call of Duty veterans to grow Battlefield as a live-service shooter. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 12:24 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @EA 🔥 React if this gives you hope · 💬 Can CoD veterans make Battlefield great again? #Battlefield #EA #CallOfDuty #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
